newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares recover at close, eyes on FOMC.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares recover at close, eyes on FOMC.

text.p: 1705 GMT - Portuguese shares recovered from the lows of the session at the close in low turnover of 5.3 billion escudos, as the market discounted a possible rise in U.S. short term rates at the FOMC meeting later today. The most active shares included Banco Comercial Portugues, Portucel, Cimpor and Portugal Telecom. Dealers said the trend of the market tomorrow would depend on the decision of the FOMC today. "As the markets have already discounted a rise in U.S. rates, if the Fed leaves them unchanged, the main markets will draw breath and rise again," a dealer said. "But even if the Fed raises rates by 25 basis points, conditions are in place for some stocks to strengthen."
